title: Accounts Assistant
company: JANE GORSE RECRUITMENT LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

Hale £26,000-£28,000

Supporting the Legal Cashiering Team

Good with numbers? Love getting the detail right? Ready for your next move in accounts?

Jane Gorse Recruitment is recruiting an Accounts Assistant to join an established law firm in Hale. You'll support the Legal Cashiering Team, helping to keep transactions accurate, payments running smoothly and financial records in excellent shape.

If you enjoy balancing the books, solving queries and being the person your colleagues can rely on, this could be a great next step.

The role

Working closely with the legal cashiers and wider business, you'll get involved in:
- Posting transactions accurately to client and office ledgers.
- Processing payments, cheque requests and account transfers.
- Completing daily bank reconciliations.
- Helping prepare weekly payment runs.
- Maintaining financial records and investigating ledger queries.
- Supporting month-end processes and VAT returns.
- Assisting with petty cash and residual client balances.
- Following the procedures that keep client money protected and accounts compliant.
- Providing cover for colleagues and suggesting ways to improve everyday processes.

What you'll bring

We're keen to hear from candidates with accounts experience, strong attention to detail and a proactive approach.

You'll be someone who:
- Enjoys working with numbers and checking that everything adds up.
- Has experience with financial transactions, reconciliations or maintaining accounts records.
- Communicates clearly and confidently with colleagues.
- Can organise a varied workload and meet deadlines.
- Handles sensitive financial information with care and discretion.
- Is comfortable using accounts software and learning new systems.
- Takes pride in being helpful, reliable and accurate.

Experience within a legal accounts team would be useful. If your background is in a different sector, please highlight your relevant accounts experience and interest in moving into legal finance.

The benefits

There's plenty on offer beyond the £25,000-£28,000 salary:
- Employee bonus scheme offering up to an additional 10% of annual salary, subject to terms and conditions.
- Your birthday off.
- Healthcare package including 24/7 GP access and contributions towards dental, optical and physiotherapy costs.
- Gym membership.
- Death-in-service cover of four times your salary.
- Company pension.
- Counselling support and monthly office massages.
- A range of lifestyle benefits, including Netflix, Spotify and Amazon Prime.

Benefits are subject to the employer's scheme terms and eligibility.

Ready to make your next move?

Apply with your CV to Jane Gorse Recruitment. We'd love to hear about your accounts experience and what you're looking for next.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant / Altrincham / Salary £28,000 - £30,000 / Office Based / Excellent Benefits / Permanent Role

Accounts Assistant Benefits
- £28,000 - £30,000
- Room for training and development
- Office based
- Amazing benefits
- Great location

Accounts Assistant Role Overview

An amazing opportunity for an Accounts Assistant to join an award winning firm based in Altrincham. As the Accounts Assistant you will handle, manage and record financial transactions, working in a busy team reporting into the Head of Finance.

Accounts Assistant Responsibilities:
- Post purchase invoices and process supplier payments.
- Process CHAPS, BACS and Faster Payments accurately and within required deadlines.
- Process client and office account transactions
- Manage daily banking, including posting receipts and processing electronic payments.
- Complete bank reconciliations and investigate any discrepancies.
- Handle client completions, ensuring funds are transferred promptly and correctly.
- Manage office expenses and petty cash where required.
- Raise client bills and allocate receipts accurately.
- Reconcile client and office ledgers on a regular basis.
- Support month-end procedures, including reconciliations and reporting.
- Prepare and submit VAT returns where applicable.

Accounts Assistant Experience Required
- Experience as an Accounts Assistant / Accounts Administrator with relevant transferable skills
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel
- Strong organisational skills and communication skills
- A proactive and positive approach with excellent problem-solving skills
- A willingness to learn, develop and adapt within a growing finance team.

Why Should you Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to work for an award-winning firm who are offering a competitive salary along with amazing benefits + excellent training and development. Apply for immediate consideration! Alternatively, send your CV directly to

We are committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all applicants of identity, personal characteristics, or background.

title: Customer Service & Sales Administrator
description:
Customer Service & Sales Administrator
Permanent Job
£24,000 plus opportunity to earn Monthly Bonus
Altrincham
35 Hours per Week - Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm
Fully Office Based

Are you highly organised, detail-focused and passionate about delivering excellent customer service?

We are looking for a Customer Service & Order Processor to join a friendly and supportive team based in Altrincham. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of customer orders from initial sale through to delivery and invoicing, ensuring every detail is managed accurately and efficiently.

Working as part of a busy customer service team, you'll manage multiple customer orders simultaneously, ensuring a smooth journey from order placement through to completion. You'll liaise with customers, sales, warehouse, procurement and finance teams, keeping everyone informed and ensuring exceptional service throughout.

Key responsibilities include:
- Processing customer orders accurately and efficiently.
- Monitoring order progress and keeping customers updated.
- Coordinating with warehouse and internal teams to ensure timely deliveries.
- Raising invoices and credit notes.
- Managing customer enquiries via email and telephone.
- Maintaining accurate records and documentation.
- Building strong relationships with customers and colleagues across the business.
- Resolving queries and issues quickly and professionally.

We're keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Experience in customer service, sales administration, order processing or a similar customer-focused administrative role.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Experience managing multiple orders.
- Confidence communicating with customers by email and phone.
- A proactive approach and the ability to take ownership of tasks.
- Strong relationship-building skills and experience working across departments.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and ideally an ERP system such as SAP.

What's on offer?
- 35-hour working week.
- Excellent benefits package including private healthcare, pension, wellbeing support and bonus opportunities.
- Free onsite parking.
- Long-term career opportunity with a successful and growing business.
- If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail and customer service excellence are valued, we'd love to hear from you.

To find out more and see a full job spec then please contact Ruth today on (phone number removed) or email (url removed)

This vacancy is being handled by Aspire Recruitment. Please be aware we receive a high volume of applications and regularly receive applications from candidates who exceed the job credentials. We will only contact you within the next 14 days if you are selected for interview.

title: Document Controller
description:
Join a reputable Architecture practice in a Document Controller role. This is an exciting opportunity to join a busy company of over 50 staff.

Full details listed below:

The Role
- Own the day-to-day running of document control across live projects, keeping records and systems in good order
- Make sure every drawing, report and piece of project information is logged correctly, named properly and sitting at the right version
- Issue information through the document management platforms on time and keep the process running smoothly
- Act as the point of contact for consultants, supply chain partners and their document controllers, coordinating submissions and keeping everyone s records aligned
- Chase up open transmittals, reviews and approvals, and raise anything that s stalling with the relevant project leads
- Run regular data checks so that what s on the system is consistent, accurate and current
- Be the go-to person for colleagues with questions about information management and the systems behind it
- Spot where processes could work better and put forward ideas to improve them

About You
- Highly organised, with a genuine eye for detail
- Comfortable communicating with people at all levels, both inside the practice and externally
- Able to keep several deadlines moving at once without letting anything slip
- Keen to learn new systems and quick to take the initiative
- Confident in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and SharePoint
- Interested in data, information management or project administration as a career path
- A background in administration Experience within the Built environment (Beneficial)
- Experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) or Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS) from the design and construction sector. (Full training will be provided)

The successful candidate will earn a salary up to £30,000-£35,000 Hybrid and flexible work arrangements and an industry leading benefits package.
